onboarding.title: Found your company
onboarding.description: A company has an accounting currency, an institution (who decides what), and you as its Owner. Hire the AI team afterwards.
onboarding.name: Company name
onboarding.templateHint: software-studio-v1: CEO · PM · Tech Lead · engineers · QA; you accept deliveries.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.description: What waits for you, what is moving, what it costs.
dashboard.noDecisions: Nothing needs your signature right now.
dashboard.todayHint: Each comes with the company's recommendation. Judge; do not research.

decision.briefNone: No recommendation yet — the advisor has not answered.

mission.title: Mission
mission.hint: The CEO agent accepts or rejects it; the PM plans; the Tech Lead approves and assigns.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Projects, their tasks, reviews and deliveries.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Propose a mission from the overview.
projects.deliverHint: Every task is done. As Owner you accept the delivery; this is a decision bound to this project.
projects.reportHint: The story so far, folded from the facts. Click a fact id to trace it.

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: People and agents employed by this company, with their evidence-based competencies.
employees.name: Name

drive.title: Drive
drive.description: Every artifact a task produced, content-addressed and attributed.
drive.gone: The content of this artifact is no longer retained.

economy.title: Economy
economy.description: The company's ledger: balances, project costs, and where each entry came from.
economy.traceHint: Paste a fact id or a journal entry id.

settings.title: Settings
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed; other sessions were signed out.
settings.institutionHint: The institution decides who decides. Customize it with a JSON patch and a reason; every change is a fact.
settings.aboutText: Eidolon v2: an immutable ledger of AI labour, a boundary of who decides, a trail for every step, running a customizable company institution.
settings.providerHint: This company's own key for its model provider. Stored encrypted; only the last four characters are ever shown. Without one, the worker uses the process-wide provider from .env.
settings.providerOwnerOnly: Only the Owner manages the provider key.
settings.providerNone: No company key configured; the default provider is used.
settings.passkeysHint: Sign in with your device's biometrics or a security key. The server keeps only public keys.
settings.passkeysUnavailable: Passkeys need a secure context (HTTPS or localhost).
